units.name: Estilos de vida, salud y bienestar
Prueba 1: tipos de texto y conectores

prompts.prompt: Name an IB learner-profile attribute in Spanish

answers.why: Inquirer: curious, asks questions and researches on their own.
Thinker: uses critical and creative thinking to solve problems.
Reflective: thinks about their own learning, strengths and weaknesses.
Communicator: expresses ideas confidently in more than one language.
Balanced: looks after mind, body and emotions. Links to the bienestar unit too.
Caring: shows empathy and helps others. Careful: not 'solitario' (lonely).
Risk-taker: faces new challenges with courage. Audaz = bold.
Principled: acts honestly and fairly. Íntegro = has integrity.
Open-minded: values other cultures and points of view.
Knowledgeable: the longest attribute name, so few remember it in full.

cards.front: How to form the present subjunctive
cards.back: yo present, drop -o, swap the vowel: -ar → -e (hable), -er/-ir → -a (coma, viva). tengo → tenga, hago → haga.

cards.front: Subjunctive irregulars not from the yo form
cards.back: ser → sea · estar → esté · ir → vaya · dar → dé · saber → sepa · haber → haya

cards.front: SER vs ESTAR in one line
cards.back: SER = permanent identity, traits, origin, job, time (DOCTOR). ESTAR = location, temporary state, emotion, action in progress (PLACE).
hay = there is/are (existence): hay muchos estudiantes. tener = to have / possess: tengo dos hermanos. Tener que = have to.
1 h 15 min, choose 1 of 3 tasks, each with 3 text-type options; 250–400 words. Criteria: A Language /12, B Message /12, C Conceptual understanding /6.
Título atractivo → Sección 1 introducción → Sección 2 beneficios → Sección 3 información práctica → Llamada a la acción.
Para/De/Fecha/Asunto, then 1 Introducción · 2 Resultados · 3 Análisis · 4 Recomendaciones · 5 Conclusión. Formal and impersonal (se).
Planning tool: Audiencia · Tipo de texto · Registro · Autor · Propósito · Oraciones (structures to use).
Plan first, then 5–6 paragraphs with one idea each, a full stop every 1–2 lines, and reread as the reader.

quiz.q: 'Solidario' as an IB learner-profile attribute means…
quiz.explain: Solidario = caring. 'Solitario' means lonely, a common mix-up.

quiz.q: Which attribute is 'risk-taker' in Spanish?
quiz.explain: Audaz = bold / risk-taker. Íntegro = principled, indagador = inquirer.

quiz.q: 'Darse cuenta de' means…
quiz.explain: Darse cuenta de = to realise. Reflexive: me doy cuenta de que...

quiz.q: Which is the correct way to say 'I make a mistake'?
quiz.explain: Spanish uses cometer un error (or equivocarse), not 'hacer un error'.

quiz.q: In the A3 social-media post, identity is compared to…
quiz.explain: Identity is like water: it adapts and escapes containers. The post also calls it a mosaico.

quiz.q: According to Texto C, stereotypes become harmful when…
choices: We use them to decide how a person must be
We share them on social media only
quiz.explain: They hurt when we stop seeing them as generalisations and use them to decide how someone should be.

quiz.q: Guaraní is co-official in which country?
quiz.explain: Paraguay. Quechua = Andes (Peru/Bolivia), náhuatl = Mexico, catalán = Spain.

quiz.q: Which word comes into Spanish from náhuatl?
quiz.explain: Chocolate, tomate and aguacate come from náhuatl. Almohada is from Arabic, fútbol from English.

quiz.q: 'La comida basura' means…
quiz.explain: Comida basura = junk food (literally 'rubbish food').

quiz.q: The three pillars of a healthy lifestyle in the class reading are actividad física, alimentación and…
quiz.explain: Actividad física, alimentación and equilibrio emocional.

quiz.q: 'Sentirse abrumado' means…
quiz.explain: Abrumado = overwhelmed. Sentirse a gusto = feel at ease; apoyado = supported.

quiz.q: 'Perjudicial' means…
quiz.explain: Perjudicial = harmful. A false friend: prejudiced is 'con prejuicios'.

quiz.q: Which word means 'physical inactivity'?
quiz.explain: El sedentarismo. Agotamiento = exhaustion, autocuidado = self-care, dependencia = addiction.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: 'Es importante que tú ___ ocho horas.' (dormir)
quiz.explain: Es importante que + subjunctive: duerm- + -as = duermas.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: 'Creo que la meditación ___ útil.' (ser)
quiz.explain: Creo que states a belief as fact, so it takes the indicative: es. No creo que would take sea.

quiz.q: Choose the correct form: 'Quiero ___ más.' (I want to sleep more)
quiz.explain: Same subject in both halves, so use the infinitive, not que + subjunctive.

quiz.q: Present subjunctive of 'ir' (yo/él):
quiz.explain: Ir → vaya. One of the irregulars not formed from the yo form (ser → sea, estar → esté).

quiz.q: Negative tú command of 'hacer':
quiz.explain: Negative tú commands use the subjunctive: no hagas.

quiz.q: Which is the correct affirmative tú command of 'relajarse'?
quiz.explain: Pronoun attached at the end plus an accent: relájate. Relájese is the usted form.

quiz.q: Which is correct?
quiz.explain: With a conjugated verb, the reflexive pronoun goes before it: me levanto.

quiz.q: Correct the boot verb: 'Nosotros ___ practicar juntos.' (poder)
quiz.explain: Nosotros sits outside the 'boot', so no stem change: podemos.

quiz.q: 'Ahora ___ cansado después de la clase.' (I'm tired)
quiz.explain: A temporary state uses estar: estoy cansado.

quiz.q: 'Mi profesor ___ una persona muy paciente.'
quiz.explain: A permanent character trait uses ser: es una persona paciente.

quiz.q: 'En mi colegio ___ muchos estudiantes internacionales.'
quiz.explain: Hay (from haber) expresses existence: there are many students.

quiz.q: '___ hambre' (I'm hungry) uses which verb?
quiz.explain: Spanish uses tener for hunger, thirst, fear, age: tengo hambre.

quiz.q: Which sentence is correct?
choices: Nos vamos a esforzar nos más
quiz.explain: Attach the pronoun to the infinitive (or put it before vamos), never both.

quiz.q: A text with Para / De / Fecha / Asunto and numbered sections with data is…
quiz.explain: That header block plus data and numbered sections is an informe.

quiz.q: Which feature belongs to a folleto rather than an informe?
quiz.explain: Folletos end with a llamada a la acción. Charts and data belong to an informe.

quiz.q: Which closing suits a formal email to a school director?
quiz.explain: Formal: Atentamente / Le saluda atentamente. Un abrazo and besos are informal.

quiz.q: Which connector introduces a CONSEQUENCE?
quiz.explain: Por lo tanto = therefore. The other three express contrast.

quiz.q: A Paper 1 blog had a title, author, image and comments section, but still scored low. The most likely reason?
quiz.explain: Blog conventions were good; the problem was organisation: a single unpunctuated paragraph.

quiz.q: In a folleto for teenagers, the safest register is…
quiz.explain: Teens are addressed with tú. The key is never switching between tú and usted.

quiz.q: Paper 1 SL word range is…
quiz.explain: SL Paper 1: 250–400 words; aim for about 300–380.
